common_execution.checkpoint_resume: not supported in first prototype; replay from immutable input; completed artifacts retained as partial if failed or cancelled

extension_rule: New modules require a registered resource profile or explicit compatible profile binding. The first-module numerical and protocol limits are not imposed by the generic experiment envelope. Common execution limits remain operational policy and are captured for every run.
status_rule: These are planned ceilings, not measured performance, accuracy or runtime guarantees. Refusal reports the effective profile, requested value and limit without silently reducing the experiment.
